messages:
elaine (GM): quick follow-up from today’s all-hands re: customer wins/losses — can we capture the top 3 themes we lost deals on and the top 3 repeat asks customers raise? need a short summary for the roadmap sync by EOW.
ajay (AE): FYI — FinPro lost us: SSO + on-prem timeline + pricing vs their infra ops cost was the trio. legal/residency language also blocked. :frowning:
maria (CS): win note: RetailCo chose us for reliable latency (stable <200ms 95th) + straightforward per-token pricing. they said transparency + predictable infra cost was deciding factor. :tada:
sam (Eng): pattern from infra teams: they want canary/A-B rollout controls per model, and easier per-route throttles. also more visibility into batch/caching behavior.
david (Sales): recurring asks we're tracking: 1) faster Private/VPC onboarding, 2) SLA for tail-latency, 3) eval integration (plug-and-play prompts + gold sets). can we prioritize comms for these? @product @eng-platform
elaine (GM): action: @kyle (Product) + @sam (Eng) — can you propose a 2-sprint plan to reduce Private onboarding friction? short bullets only, due Wed.
kyle (Product): got it. current plan (high level): bootstrap automation for infra, onboarding runbook + scripts, clearer KMS/HSM checklist, and a Sales-facing checklist for legal clauses. i'll share a draft Tue.
ajay (AE): another note from FinPro — pricing comparison to self-hosted open models was a hard objection. sales could use a clear cost-comparison template (TCO calc) per vertical.
maria (CS): wins: also several start-ups said Redwood Optimize recommendations directly cut their monthly token spend by ~20% — that's a strong case study for PLG signups.
sam (Eng): technical ask: expose prefix/KV cache hit rates per-tenant in Console and a simple metric for effective batching. engineering effort estimate: 1 sprint for backend + 0.5 for UI.
elaine (GM): collectables: can someone pull 3 short customer quotes (one enterprise win, one loss quote that informs roadmap, one PLG win) so leadership can use in the next roadmap update? keep them to one sentence each.
david (Sales): i'll pull quotes from RetailCo + two trials. target Thu EOD.
elaine (GM): also, legal wants a canonical contract snippet for residency/KMS guarantees — @eng-platform can we surface a recommended clause for sales/legal review?
sam (Eng): we can draft recommended language; will need input from Security for encryption specifics.
kyle (Product): note: prioritization ask — should we treat Private onboarding automation as a product sprint or an infra reliability project? leaning product (customer-facing) but needs eng-platform support.
elaine (GM): decision: product-led sprint with eng-platform partnership. kyle + sam to align and post a short ownership map.
deploy-bot: agenda doc uploaded: https://redwood/documents/all-hands/followup.ics (shared by deploy-bot)
elaine (GM): proposing a quick 30-min follow-up Friday 9:00am PT to review the bullets and quotes. thumbs if you can make it, otherwise reply with conflicts.
maria (CS): :thumbsup:
ajay (AE): :thumbsup:
david (Sales): :thumbsup:
sam (Eng): busy Fri morning; can do 10:30am PT if we need to shift.
kyle (Product): :thumbsup: can make 9:00 am
elaine (GM): noted — polling for 9:00 vs 10:30. i'll schedule based on majority. thanks everyone, this was super helpful — please add any missing asks here.
